$schema.description: Optional schema reference URL for editor autocompletion.

workspaces.description: List of single 'Cargo.toml' workspaces and project manifests.

configs.description: List of single 'rrdu.toml' or legacy '.rrduconfig' sub-workspaces. Key represents the label, value represents the path to the sub-configuration directory or file.

additionalProperties.description: Path to the sub-configuration directory or file (e.g. 'crates/sub/'). Traversal outside root is rejected.

rrdu.description: Workspace runner and CLI interactive options.

max-lines.description: Amount of lines rendered in the interactive CLI list/scroll view.

version.description: Version of rrdu with which this configuration file was created or migrated.

exclude.description: List of folders or project directories to ignore during recursive discovery.

label.description: Optional display label. Defaults to the table key (project name) if omitted.

path.description: Path to the directory containing Cargo.toml or directly to Cargo.toml, relative to this config file. Traversal outside root is forbidden.

section.description: Section-specific exclusions. Keys can be section names (e.g. 'dev-dependencies' or 'dependencies.clap'). Values are arrays of dependency names, or an empty array to exclude the ￹entire section.
